remarks: Discover your new home in this beautifully updated apartment, featuring a spacious bedroom adorned with elegant bamboo floors. As you enter, you'll appreciate the convenient hallway storage, perfect for keeping your space organized. Step into the inviting living room, which offers versatility as both a cozy lounge area and a productive office space. Adjacent to the living room, you'll find a generously sized, modern bathroom, designed for comfort and style. The heart of the home is the bright eat-in kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, and stunning granite countertops-ideal for culinary enthusiasts and entertaining guests. Additionally, a small laundry room and extra storage area off the kitchen add to the unit's practicality. Located just minutes from Metro North and public transportation, shopping along Connecticut Ave, and the beautiful Calf Pasture Beach, this apartment is perfectly situated for an active lifestyle. Plus, you're just a short stroll away from the vibrant heart of downtown Norwalk. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity-submit your offer today before this exceptional unit is gone!
